title: Phone calls
description: The phone call capability, contract call/1. Apps that place calls declare uses call/1#dial on an action; a tenant administrator binds an implementation in Admin → Capabilities. Until then the entry stays hidden.

zh-CN.The phone call capability, contract call: 语音通话能力契约（call/1）。需要外呼的应用在动作上声明 uses call/1#dial，由管理员在“管理 → 能力连接器”中绑定实现；绑定前外呼入口自动隐藏。
zh-CN.Place an outbound phone call. The implem: 发起外呼电话，由所绑定的通话实现返回通话记录编号。
zh-CN.Places a call and answers with its call: 拨出电话并返回通话记录编号
